items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dorothy Donegan said, “You really look like Jo Jones now.”

ctx.x: Why do you say he was even Papa back then?

He was – this guy – they used to tell me I look like him. Then later on, Dorothy Donegan said, “You really look like Jo Jones now.” I said, “Yes, I wear it well.” She said, “You have no choice.” That was my guy, man.
How about local drummers in the Boston area?
